ig_caption:
If you paste it every time, it should be a skill 📌

💬 Prompt: one request. Type it, it's gone.
📚 Skill: reusable know-how, loaded when a task needs it.
🛠 MCP tool: an action on a real system (database, tickets, cloud).

The test I use at work:
→ a how-to? skill
→ touches a real system? tool
→ a one-off? just prompt it

And the best skills call tools: the skill says how, the tool does it.

Part 4/5 of AI Skills Explained. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.

#AIAgents #AgentSkills #MCP #GenAI #AIArchitect
